overview: List-of-papers sheets index 1930-34 Dairen telephone statistics for Kwantung and parts of Manchuria, tracking AT&T correspondence and geographic reporting boundaries among Kwantung, the Railway Zone, and the Mukden/Harbin districts, filed under 892.75 and 893.75.

subfiles.title: List of papers on telephone service in Kwantung, entries 2a–4
subfiles.about: Indexes early correspondence and statistical forms concerning government and private telephone systems in the Kwantung Leased Territory.
subfiles.summary: Lists Kwantung telephone questionnaires, an AT&T 1930 letter, and Coville's despatch, cross-referenced to 892.75/83 for AT&T's thanks.

subfiles.title: List of papers on Kwantung and Manchurian telephone statistics, entries 5–7
subfiles.about: Indexes three Dairen consular reports on telephone statistics in the Kwantung Leased Territory and wider Manchuria between 1931 and 1934.
subfiles.summary: Lists Langdon's 1931 Kwantung telephone statistics, Thomas's 1932 despatch, and Vincent's 1934 despatch on Mukden/Harbin-Manchuria coverage, cross-referenced to related files.

interest: Shows fragmented Manchurian telephone-reporting geography across Kwantung, the Railway Zone, and Mukden/Harbin districts.
